title: SensorDash · Reporting summary
description: Daily, weekly and monthly telemetry summaries. Choose Last 24 hours, Last 7 days or Last 30 days in the Grafana time picker. Values reflect only recorded samples; offline intervals are not imputed. Hardware identity uses SensorDash metadata, not sensor ID patterns. Estimated accessory watts are not metered energy. GPU device families include GpuAmd, GpuNvidia and GpuIntel. Fan RPM statistics use role-bound radiator and pump sensors separately. Period-over-period comparisons use an equal duration and yield no value when either period is absent; rolling 24h peaks are not calendar-day aggregates. Sensor-stream presence is an observation indicator, not a percentage of PC uptime. Detailed temperature/power history and cooling accessory/fan timelines are provided on the dedicated Hardware Telemetry, Cooling and Electricity dashboards rather than duplicated here. Historical analysis refreshes every five minutes rather than polling a 30-day window every 15 seconds.

options.content:
### HARDWARE SUMMARY · OBSERVED SAMPLES
Use the Grafana time picker: 24 hours / 7 days / 30 days. Empty means no matching observations, **not zero**. Peaks are over recorded samples only.

panels.title: CPU · peak temperature
panels.description: peak of available recorded temperature observations for Cpu; missing/offline periods are excluded. Multiple sensors are aggregated, not interpreted as a single package-specific probe. Highest individual sensor in the selected time range, with the originating sensor identified below the value; not an aggregate of multiple sensors. Highest individual reading in the selected range. Displays the originating SensorDash alias or sensor name, with underscores normalized for display. Missing current sensor catalog can make this card unavailable.

options.content:
### COOLING · SEPARATE HARDWARE ROLES
Radiator fan-group and fixed-speed DDC pump readings are shown separately using the cooling bindings configured in SensorDash. NVMe fan readings are **not** mixed in. Tachometer RPM is actual feedback; PWM duty is not proof of physical speed.

panels.title: Radiator fan group · peak RPM
panels.description: Peak observed radiator fan tachometer reading from SensorDash cooling bindings; NVMe and other unrelated fans are excluded. Does not infer the speed of individual fans on the shared hub. Highest individual sensor in the selected time range, with the originating sensor identified below the value; not an aggregate of multiple sensors. Highest individual reading in the selected range. Displays the originating SensorDash alias or sensor name, with underscores normalized for display. Missing current sensor catalog can make this card unavailable.

targets.expr: label_transform(label_transform((topk(1, max_over_time(sensordash_reading_value{host=~"$host",kind="Fan"}[$__range]) * on(host,sensor) group_right() (sensordash_cooling_binding_value{host=~"$host",kind="Fan",role="fan-group"} == 1))) * on(host,sensor) group_left(display) (label_replace(sensordash_sensor_info_value{host=~"$host",kind="Fan",alias!="unassigned"} == 1, "display", "$1", "alias", "(.+)") or label_replace(sensordash_sensor_info_value{host=~"$host",kind="Fan",alias="unassigned"} == 1, "display", "$1", "name", "(.+)")), "display", "_+", " "), "display", "^ +| +$", "")

options.content:
### REPORTING COVERAGE & RETRY BUFFER
Recording density and sensor-stream presence show observed samples, **not PC uptime**. Windows SQLite bytes are the local export retry spool, not the compressed long-term VictoriaMetrics history. For detailed live hardware, cooling and accessory electrical histories, open their dedicated dashboards.

panels.title: Recording density · observations per 5 minutes
panels.description: Shows gaps and reporting density, not a percentage of uptime. If the PC sleeps, lower counts are expected.

options.content:
### COMPARE EQUAL-LENGTH PERIODS · OBSERVED SAMPLES
The **selected range** is compared with the immediately preceding range of equal duration (24 hours versus the previous 24 hours; 7 days versus the previous 7 days; 30 days versus the previous 30 days). Differences are current minus previous. A blank result means one period has insufficient observations. These are *observed sensor statistics*, not room-temperature-adjusted benchmarks.

panels.title: CPU peak temperature · change
panels.description: Difference between the current selected period and the preceding equally long period. Requires observations in both periods; no zero-filling. Values combine available sensors in the device family, not necessarily a single package probe.

options.content:
### DAILY TREND · ROLLING 24-HOUR PEAKS
Each point is the highest recorded CPU or GPU temperature during the preceding 24 hours, not an average and not a peak for a fixed calendar day. Gaps are preserved; incomplete windows can miss true peaks.

panels.title: CPU · rolling 24h temperature peak
panels.description: Rolling maximum of observed physical temperature readings in the preceding 24 hours. Offline gaps are not reconstructed.

panels.title: GPU · rolling 24h temperature peak
panels.description: Rolling maximum of observed physical temperature readings in the preceding 24 hours. Offline gaps are not reconstructed.

panels.title: Temperature sensors reporting within 1 hour
panels.description: Per-computer count of CPU temperature sensor streams with observations in the prior hour. GPU is a separate series, never an average.

panels.title: Windows local telemetry buffer · disk footprint
panels.description: Current SQLite main database, WAL and SHM file bytes sampled through time. Not the size of individual sensors in VictoriaMetrics.
